items_flat.title_en: OpenAI previews Private Safety Processing to strengthen multi-turn safety while preserving Zero Data Retention
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 預覽 Private Safety Processing，在維持 Zero Data Retention 下強化多輪安全偵測
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced it will continue offering Zero Data Retention for frontier models and is previewing Private Safety Processing. The system identifies risk patterns across related interactions via automated signals without giving OpenAI personnel access to customer content. Customer data can stay on customer-controlled infrastructure or be stored encrypted with customer-held keys; a broader rollout and technical white paper are planned for September.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布將持續為前沿模型提供 Zero Data Retention，並預覽 Private Safety Processing。該系統透過自動化訊號識別跨相關互動的風險模式，且不讓 OpenAI 人員接觸客戶內容。資料可留在客戶自控基礎設施，或以客戶持有金鑰加密儲存；預計九月擴大推出並發布技術白皮書。
items_flat.analysis_en: This directly addresses enterprise privacy concerns amid rising agentic and multi-turn risks, positioning OpenAI against competitors that require longer data retention for safety. Key uncertainty is whether the narrow safety signals prove sufficient in practice once agents become more autonomous.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉直接回應企業在代理式與多輪風險上升下的隱私顧慮，並與要求較長資料保留的競爭對手形成差異。關鍵不確定性在於，當代理更自主時，僅回傳窄幅安全訊號是否仍足夠有效。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re previewing Private Safety Processing, which is designed to identify patterns across related interactions without giving OpenAI personnel access to the underlying content.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們預覽 Private Safety Processing，其設計目標是在不讓 OpenAI 人員接觸底層內容的情況下，識別跨相關互動的模式。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches ChatGPT for Teens with learning focus and default safety protections
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT for Teens，強調學習功能與預設安全保護
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced ChatGPT for Teens, an experience that automatically activates for users estimated or stating ages 13-17. It prioritizes Study Mode, responsible homework reminders, quizzes, and parental controls while applying stricter default safety protections.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布推出 ChatGPT for Teens，針對估計或自報 13-17 歲用戶自動啟用。產品優先提供 Study Mode、負責任的作業提醒、測驗與家長控制，並套用更嚴格的預設安全保護。
items_flat.analysis_en: This formalizes age-tiered product design under regulatory and public pressure. Effectiveness will depend on age-prediction accuracy and whether Study Mode meaningfully reduces short-term harmful use.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉在監管與公眾壓力下正式化分齡產品設計。成效將取決於年齡預測準確度，以及 Study Mode 能否實質降低短期有害使用。
items_flat.quote: We’re introducing ChatGPT for Teens, an experience designed to help teens learn, think critically, deepen understanding, and use AI with confidence.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們推出 ChatGPT for Teens，這是一個專為幫助青少年學習、批判思考、深化理解，並有信心使用 AI 而設計的體驗。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI paces frontier development after cyber-capability thresholds and Hugging Face incident
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 在網路能力門檻與 Hugging Face 事件後調整前沿開發節奏
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published that it temporarily slowed reinforcement-learning training and is expanding monitoring, alignment, and security after the Hugging Face incident and preliminary evidence that its upcoming Astra model may meet Critical cybersecurity thresholds under its Preparedness Framework.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 發布聲明，在 Hugging Face 事件後，以及初步證據顯示即將推出的 Astra 模型可能達到 Preparedness Framework 下的 Critical 網路安全門檻後，暫時放慢強化學習訓練，並擴大監控、對齊與安全措施。
items_flat.analysis_en: The post signals that cyber capability growth is now directly constraining training cadence at a frontier lab. Key uncertainty remains how long the pause lasts and whether peer labs adopt similar public pacing.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此文顯示網路能力成長已直接制約前沿實驗室的訓練節奏。關鍵不確定性在於暫停會持續多久，以及其他實驗室是否採取類似公開節奏調整。
items_flat.quote: We wanted to take the time necessary to meet those standards, so we temporarily slowed the pace of scaling.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們希望花必要時間達到那些標準，因此暫時放緩了擴展節奏。

items_flat.title_en: Grok 4.6 now generally available on Amazon Bedrock
items_flat.title_zh: Grok 4.6 正式於 Amazon Bedrock 全面可用
items_flat.summary_en: xAI announced that Grok 4.6 is now generally available on Amazon Bedrock. The model offers a 500k context window and configurable reasoning levels, targeted at long-running agents and interactive work, with listed pricing of $2/$6 per million tokens (Global cross-Region).
items_flat.summary_zh: xAI 宣布 Grok 4.6 已於 Amazon Bedrock 全面可用。該模型具備 50 萬 token 上下文視窗與可配置推理等級，面向長時運行代理與互動工作，定價為每百萬 token 輸入 $2／輸出 $6（Global cross-Region）。
items_flat.analysis_en: Bedrock availability expands enterprise distribution for Grok beyond direct API and GitHub Copilot, lowering friction for AWS-centric teams. Uptake will depend on real-world agent performance and pricing competitiveness versus other frontier models on the same platform.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Bedrock 上架擴大 Grok 在企業端的分發管道，超越直接 API 與 GitHub Copilot，降低 AWS 生態團隊的採用門檻。實際採用量將取決於代理實務表現，以及與同平台其他前沿模型的價格競爭力。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re excited to announce that Grok 4.6 is now generally available on Amazon Bedrock.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們很高興宣布 Grok 4.6 已於 Amazon Bedrock 全面可用。
